title: lagrange operations
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate Lagrange geometric operations: contour, boundary, clip, cut on higher-order elements.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCellArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellArray.html) — cell array.
- [vtkClipDataSet](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkClipDataSet.html) — clip data set.
- [vtkColorSeries](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkColorSeries.html) — color series.
- [vtkContourFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContourFilter.html) — extracts iso-surfaces at specified scalar values.
- [vtkCutter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCutter.html) — cutter.
- [vtkDataSet](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSet.html) — data set.
- [vtkDataSetMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetMapper.html) — maps any dataset type to graphics primitives.
- [vtkDataSetSurfaceFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetSurfaceFilter.html) — data set surface filter.
- [vtkDoubleArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDoubleArray.html) — double array.
- [vtkGlyph3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3D.html) — places oriented, scaled glyphs at each point.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkMinimalStandardRandomSequence](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMinimalStandardRandomSequence.html) — minimal standard random sequence.
- [vtkPlane](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlane.html) — defines an implicit plane function.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyData.html) — represents polygonal geometry.
- [vtkPolyDataNormals](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataNormals.html) — computes surface normals for smooth shading.
- [vtkSphereSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphereSource.html) — generates a tessellated sphere.
- [vtkUnstructuredGridGeometryFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUnstructuredGridGeometryFilter.html) — unstructured grid geometry filter.
- [vtkVariant](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVariant.html) — variant.
- [vtkXMLUnstructuredGridReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkXMLUnstructuredGridReader.html) — reads VTK XML unstructured grid files.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
